title: Roblox Pressured Us to Delete Our Video. So We Dug Deeper.
summary: A People Make Games follow-up investigation into Roblox, built on stories from players and creators after the channel's first video. It covers the platform's treatment of young developers and its moderation.
why: Cited heavily in Roblox threads as a damning investigation into child labor, exploitation, and weak moderation, and suggested viewing for parents.

quote.text: Watch both People Make Games video about Roblox and try to argue that the company should not deserve all the public controversy it is getting.
